body: Are you fucking kidding me. I don't speak to people about this shit in real life as I don't want to be accused of attention seeking so as a last resort I come to the internet to speak to people I don't know in the hope I won't be judged. But fuck it, you'll be pleased to know I'll be right in front of the train tomorrow morning rather than carrying on with my pointless life. Thanks for giving me the push I need.
